attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Indiana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts, no transaction count as of Jan 1, 2024); result.in_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.in_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. IN requires addback of out-of-state municipal bond interest acquired after 12/31/2011.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Indiana state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.in_state_additions = 0.0; if result.in_out_of_state_muni_interest != 0.0 then set result.in_state_additions = result.in_state_additions + result.in_out_of_state_muni_interest; endif set result.in_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.in_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.in_state_subtractions = result.in_state_subtractions + result.in_municipal_interest; endif if result.in_state_taxes_paid != 0.0 then set result.in_state_subtractions = result.in_state_subtractions + result.in_state_taxes_paid; endif add (("Indiana additions: $" + string value of (result.in_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.in_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.in_state_additions xdef { result.in_state_additions result.in_out_of_state_muni_interest f+ cvd /result.in_state_additions xdef } {} result.in_out_of_state_muni_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.in_state_subtractions xdef { result.in_state_subtractions result.in_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.in_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.in_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse { result.in_state_subtractions result.in_state_taxes_paid f+ cvd /result.in_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.in_state_taxes_paid 0.0 f== not ifelse "Indiana additions: $" result.in_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.in_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana corporate income tax. Applies Indiana flat rate (4.9%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.in_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Indiana corporate tax (flat rate 4.9%); Apply Indiana 4.9% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.in_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.in_apportioned_income + result.in_state_additions - result.in_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.in_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.in_taxable_income * result.in_corp_tax_rate - result.in_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.in_refund_or_owed = result.in_estimated_payments - result.in_tax_liability; add "Indiana taxable income: $" + string value of (result.in_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Indiana tax liability (4.9%): $" + string value of (result.in_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.in_apportioned_income result.in_state_additions f+ result.in_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.in_taxable_income xdef result.in_taxable_income result.in_corp_tax_rate fmul result.in_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.in_tax_liability xdef result.in_estimated_payments result.in_tax_liability f- cvd /result.in_refund_or_owed xdef "Indiana taxable income: $" result.in_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Indiana tax liability (4.9%): $" result.in_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
